To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) there is a lack of consensus among the accreditation standards of the professional fields studied; (2) the standards of each professional field are not comprehensive in that they do not address all elements of quality professional education; (3) the standards of some fields are more specific and detailed than those of other fields; and (4) there are some areas in which all fields have similar standards, but other areas in which the fields are quite dissimilar.

the accreditation standards for the selected professional fields do emphasize many elements of quality professional education, but the extent to which these standards are applied to the professional education program varies.
